The matching elements are the intersection.

function.description: Propose a salt string for the PSI handshake. The shim hashes leaves under the lex-min of both salts.
function.name: propose_salt

function.description: Commit to your private set's Merkle root + cardinality. The shim computes both; you only call this tool to advance.
function.name: commit_set

function.description: Reveal the SHA-256 leaves of your salted private set. The shim computes the leaves; you only call this tool to advance.
function.name: reveal_leaves

function.description: Claim the plaintext members you believe are in the intersection of your set and Bob's set. Members must be elements of your own set.
function.name: claim_intersection

members.description: Plaintext members claimed to be in A ∩ B.

function.description: Submit your final answer to the operator. Members must be elements of your own set; the operator scores this submission.
function.name: finalize

The matching elements are the intersection.
function.name: hash_element
